verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for finance and expense software, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes Ramp only as a hosted SaaS service (ramp.com, mcp.ramp.com, demo.ramp.com sandbox) and documents no self-hosted deployment. The open-source CLI and the hosted sandbox are client tools and a test environment, not a self-hostable core product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
